title: MarketPricesAndTechnicalAnalysis
description: Schema for storing current market share prices, daily trading volumes, historical OHLCV candlestick series, and technical analysis indicators supporting price prediction and grounded valuation.

symbol.description: Ticker symbol of the public equity.

current_price.description: Most recent verified market closing or regular trading price.

previous_close.description: Official closing price of the prior regular trading session.

day_change.description: Net price change in dollars relative to previous close.

day_change_percent.description: Percentage price change relative to previous close.

day_open.description: Opening price of the latest trading session.

day_high.description: Intraday high price of the latest trading session.

day_low.description: Intraday low price of the latest trading session.

day_volume.description: Total share volume traded during the latest regular session.

average_volume_20d.description: 20-day rolling average daily share trading volume.

volume_ratio.description: Ratio of latest day volume to 20-day average volume (identifies accumulation/distribution breakouts).

fifty_two_week_high.description: Highest traded price in the preceding 52-week trailing window.

fifty_two_week_low.description: Lowest traded price in the preceding 52-week trailing window.

sma_20.description: 20-day Simple Moving Average (short-term trend & mean reversion benchmark).

sma_50.description: 50-day Simple Moving Average (intermediate institutional support/resistance level).

technical_support_20d.description: Estimated short-term support level based on recent 20-day swing lows.

technical_resistance_20d.description: Estimated short-term resistance level based on recent 20-day swing highs.

historical_candles_30d.description: Chronological array of daily OHLCV candlestick records for charting and technical modeling.

provenance_source.description: Authoritative feed or API endpoint name.
